about: The live menu for planner v2.1: the public LibriVox clips a live run may use. The planner rebuilds its clip_id enum from this file on every request, so adding a clip needs no code change. Each excerpt's intact 16 kHz mono wav is on stillhere/public_audio_allowlist.txt. A plan for a stimulus that is not on this menu ends on its evidence panel, never on a live clip's output.

le_petit_prince.line: Le Petit Prince is not on the live menu, so this plan ends on its evidence panel: the held-out section 8 result.
